fixture.what: The S7.28 synthetic area (21 packages x 2,000 squares, 42,000 features, drawn by window at its 15,000-building limit) with a batch whose large GeoJSON keeps being read: its read preview gains 60 outlines a second.
fixture.answeredBy: Playwright routes in E:/ulpin-tmp/s7-28b/fixture.mjs (copied from S7.28); no server, no real data
fixture.browser: Playwright Chromium headed, production build served by vite preview, 1440 x 900
fixture.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (0x00002488) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
fixture.recorder: E:/ulpin-tmp/s7-28b/measure.mjs: once 15,000 buildings are drawn, draw calls of one frame, 10 synced single renders (render plus a one-pixel read back), then PerformanceObserver long tasks and requestAnimationFrame gaps over 2 minutes of right-drag orbiting and 1 minute still, the preview growing throughout

cause: Each footprint building was its own Mesh and its own EdgesGeometry LineSegments, drawn again in the shadow pass: about 39,000 draw calls for 15,000 buildings, about 90 ms per render.
fix: Resting footprint buildings draw from batches (packages/scene/src/building-batch.ts) of up to 2,000 buildings of one rest look: one mesh and one set of edges each, filled in place as buildings arrive. A building that looks unlike its batch (selected, hovered, see-through near an explored building, still growing in) is collapsed in the batch and draws as its own mesh, which picks keep testing. Batching is always on; storey-by-storey buildings stay as before.

look.how: Screenshots of the canvas at one fixed camera (target at the drawn area's centre, camera 70 m east, 60 m up, 85 m south of it), at rest, with the centre building hovered and with it selected; before and after compared pixel by pixel

checks: resting buildings of one look draw as one mesh and one set of edges, and a pick on each returns its id
selecting a building writes only its own range in the batch; moving the selection writes only the old and the new range
outcome colours stay in the batch of thematic buildings; a hovered building draws as its own mesh
changing or removing a building leaves an untouched batch identical by reference (mesh, edges, geometries, buffer version)
a growing building draws as its own mesh until it has grown in, then joins a batch
